action_items: Backend suite ran with no tests collected (pytest exit 5); no API-bearing criterion is present.

checks.criterion: Portfolio renders as a modern responsive one-page experience with a light white-and-black editorial theme
checks.name: portfolio-renders-editorial
checks.evidence: Persisted browser check passed at the saved mobile viewport; portfolio, logo, hero heading, and mobile navigation toggle rendered.

checks.criterion: Primary navigation reaches the requested sections
checks.name: portfolio-navigation-sections
checks.evidence: Persisted browser check passed; section anchors and mobile About navigation completed successfully.

checks.criterion: Theme toggle works without breaking the page
checks.name: portfolio-theme-toggle
checks.evidence: Persisted browser check passed; theme toggled and the page retained the hero before restoring light mode.

checks.criterion: Deployment section covers AWS, Vercel, and Render
checks.name: portfolio-deployment-tabs
checks.evidence: Persisted browser check passed; AWS, Vercel, and Render panels and content were verified.

checks.criterion: Project showcase preserves all six projects with animated card presentation
checks.name: portfolio-project-showcase
checks.evidence: Persisted browser check passed; all six project cards and representative action links were verified.

checks.criterion: Contact area provides presentation-only contact actions
checks.name: portfolio-contact-actions
checks.evidence: Persisted browser check passed; email/social links, Hire Me mailto, and copy-email feedback were verified.

checks.criterion: LeetCode section preserves the displayed profile stats
checks.name: portfolio-leetcode-stats
checks.evidence: Updated persisted check passed on the public preview URL after scrolling LeetCode into view and waiting for Easy/Medium/Hard counts to settle at 28/31/3; total 62 and profile link also verified.

checks.criterion: Hero text “Hi, I’m Adnan Pal” has visible staggered animation treatment
checks.name: portfolio-hero-staggered-heading
checks.evidence: Persisted browser check passed; complete aria label, four separate word elements, and settled visible opacity were verified.

checks.criterion: LeetCode progress has animated counts and progress bars
checks.name: portfolio-leetcode-animated-progress
checks.evidence: Persisted browser check passed; after scrolling into view, total 62, counts 28/31/3, and progress values 45/50/5 were verified.
